role: RECENSION_LATIN (the Latin text and its lines); MODERN_EDITORIAL (the editor's page heads, folio notes in the margin and footnotes)
comment: Frame 019, printed p. 13: the proof of multiplication by casting out nines, continued; the beginning of division: the number to be divided written above, the divisor below it, shifted to the right when the highest place above is smaller; the quotient found and multiplied into the divisor, the product subtracted.

observations: The page number «( 13 )» stands at the head of the page, centred. The page has no footnotes and no signature.
L20: «plus 1 :», the figure one, an old-style arabic numeral with a flag at its top, between word spaces (20 and 23 px), in the Latin text.

L24: «superioriorem(sic)quem»: the edition marks the form with «(sic)» in italics, set close to the words on both sides (6 and 4 px). L25: the vertical bar between «aliquem» and «numerum», set close to both words, marks the beginning of fol. 106 verso of the manuscript, which the note in the right margin, «car. 106 verso.», names; transcribed as a margin note.

Spaces at punctuation (rule of tools/punct.py: after a mark, a space where the gap is at least 12 px or two thirds of the median word space of the line; before a mark, where it is at least 10 px): with a space before the mark, L13 «suas :» (21 px) and L20 «1 :» (23 px); without a space after the mark, L08 «aliam;et» (10 px, the median word space of the line 15.5 px), L21 «diuidis,sub» (11 px, median 17 px) and L31 «diuiditur.Iterum» (9 px, median 15 px); L09 «.ix.; et» (12 px, median 16.5 px) has a space. The commas of L17 «diuidere,» and L18 «diuidis,» stand 8 px from the word, without a space.
Marks not transcribed: light specks at mid-height between «per» and «differentias» (L13) and between «quem» and «diuidis» (L27).
copy_matter: A reader's notes in pencil: «proice» in the right margin beside L04, with «proinde» underlined; «erit» in the left margin beside L06, with «erunt» underlined, and «erit» faintly in the right margin; «quia hoc erit» beside L07, with «quare hec erunt» underlined; «fuerit» beside L09, with «fuit» underlined; «quia» beside L10, with «quare» underlined; faint erased words in the right margin beside L08-L09; L14, «quem» underlined; «idest» in the right margin beside L20, with a stroke under «1 :»; L21, a stroke over «diuidis»; «cum» in the right margin beside L25, with «inde» underlined; L29, a stroke after «numeri,»; «sollte · quo sein» (German, should be «quo») in the right margin beside L31; L32, a stroke over «succedit». Not part of the edition.
